sections.title: 🎯 What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ever wondered why some variables work everywhere in your code while others don't? Let's explore variable scope!

• What variable scope really means
• Where variables can (and can't) be used
• How to avoid common scope mistakes

sections.title: 💡 Concept Explanation
sections.content:
Imagine your variable is like a house guest:
- Some guests (variables) can visit your whole house (program)
- Others are only allowed in certain rooms (methods/blocks)
- If you try to talk to a guest who isn't in the room, you'll get an error!

Variables have boundaries where they can be used. These boundaries are called 'scope'.

• **Local variables**: Only exist inside the method where they're declared
• **Class variables**: Can be used anywhere in the class
• **Block variables**: Only exist inside { } braces where they're created

sections.content: Step-by-step visualization of how variable scope works:

steps.title: Variable Declaration
steps.description: When you declare a variable, it gets its own 'room' (scope). The variable k doesn't exist yet, so this would cause an error.

steps.title: Correct Scope
steps.description: Now k is declared in the same scope as i, so it works. Both variables exist in the main method's 'room'.

steps.title: Nested Scope
steps.description: Variables declared in inner blocks can't be used outside. The outer block can't see blockVar.

sections.title: ⚡ Key Points
points: ✓ Scope determines where a variable can be used
✓ Variables must be declared before use
✓ Local variables only exist in their method/block
✓ Class variables can be used anywhere in the class
✓ Trying to use a variable outside its scope causes errors

sections.title: 🔥 Tips & Mistakes
dos: Declare variables in the smallest scope needed
Initialize variables when you declare them
Check variable scope when you get 'not found' errors
donts: Don't use variables before declaring them
Don't declare variables in large scopes if they're only needed locally
Don't forget to initialize variables before use
Don't assume variables from one method exist in another
sections.protip: When in doubt, ask: 'Where was this variable declared?' That's its scope!

sections.title: 🌍 Real World Use
sections.content: Where is variable scope used in real apps?

examples.how: Transaction variables only exist in their transaction methods, while account balance variables exist at the class level
Player health might be a class variable, while temporary power-up effects are local variables in methods
Request-specific variables exist only during the request, while configuration variables exist for the whole application

problem.description: Find and fix all scope-related errors in this code. The program should calculate the area of a circle (πr²) and print it.
hints: Which variables can be seen by which methods?
Where should the area variable be declared?
What's the scope of the radius variable?
problem.explanation: The original code had two scope issues: radius wasn't visible in calculateArea(), and area wasn't visible in main(). The solution passes radius as a parameter and returns the calculated area.

sections.title: 📝 Summary
points: 📌 Variable scope defines where a variable can be used
📌 Always declare variables before using them
📌 Practice identifying scope by looking at { } braces
📌 Ready to learn about method parameters next!
